decisions.statement: Ensemble buyout: agency is modelled in domain 01. The contractor's consent binds only where domain 01 records the agency relationship — the players authorised it in advance, so the consents are delegated, not manufactured, which is what makes 09.02.01 D-12 true without violating 09.02.03 D-16. Interim, until domain 01 models agency: require the 14 individual extinguishments, but let the session close on the fee designation so money and credits are right while the buyout is pending. 09.02.03 D-16 stands.

crossDomainNotes.note: The contractor→player agency relationship. An ensemble buyout can close on one consent only where domain 01 holds a record that the players authorised the contractor to bind them in advance — that record is what makes the 14 consents delegated rather than manufactured, and it is the sole end condition on 09.02.01 D-18's interim posture. Domain 01 owns the authority, its engagement scope, its evidence and its revocation. Domain 09 owns none of it, must not infer it (09.02.01 D-14), and will not bulk-consent without it (09.02.03 D-16). Routed via 09.02.03 Q-06 and 09.02.01 Q-03 at /create-prd-security.
